localCountermodel.details: A reappears at top-right after B moves away; keep B middle-right and C bottom-right identical

visualFacets.watermarkRule: Original top-right; moved middle-right; independent control bottom-right. Every subject/control and original absence window must be clear of native legend, watermark and every other occluder. No top-left or bottom-left table in either candidate.
